text:
deploy-bot: Post-deploy smoke checks for release v3.7.1 -> 3/5 synth probes failing in eu-west-1. Circuit breaker engaged, rollout paused. Rolling back automatically in 5m unless acknowledged.

maria: @sre-oncall oncall — any initial read? :eyes:

alex: seeing 502s from route /api/generate in the synth logs, spike around 11:23 UTC. Minimal errors in app logs though.

sre-oncall: can you paste the synth output snip? also signal whether it's 502 client or upstream

alex: paste:
```
[11:22:58] probe /api/generate -> 502 Bad Gateway (upstream timeout)
[11:23:01] probe /api/generate -> 502
[11:23:04] probe /api/health -> 200 (latency 620ms)
```

kevin: @alex hmm latency ~600ms on /api/health looks like transient tail latency, could be KV cache cold or batching change. We recently enabled async batching on canary.

joanne: I reproduced a slow 200 locally against the canary: `curl -w "%{time_total}" -s -o /dev/null https://canary.eu-west-1/api/health` -> 0.58

maria: so failures are synth 502s but app returns 200 sometimes. Maybe probe fanout + rate limiter causing upstream overload -> 502 gateway.

sre-oncall: decision options: 1) let circuit-breaker rollback (auto) 2) pin traffic back to previous stable 3) increase probe debounce and keep canary pinned while we triage. Prefer option 3 to avoid noisy rollback if it's probe config.

kevin: +1 option 3. We can bump synth concurrency down and increase debounce to 3 failures within 2m. Quick patch in probe config and re-run.

maria: is there a fast rollback plan if triage shows real regressions? deploy-bot, what's ETA to rollback?

deploy-bot: rollback job queued. Estimated completion ~3 minutes once triggered. Current state: pause -> will rollback automatically at 11:28 UTC unless acknowledged.

joanne: I'll push a probe config patch now to reduce fanout: `/infra/synth/configs/eu-west-1.json` changing concurrency 50 -> 10 and debounce 2->3

alex: pushed config PR, triggering re-run: https://git.internal/pr/4621

monitoring-bot: Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/abcd/smoke-probes?orgId=1&from=now-15m

sre-oncall: OK halting automatic rollback. We'll apply the probe change, re-run probes, and if failures persist for 6m we'll revert to rollback. @deploy-bot cancel auto-rollback.

deploy-bot: auto-rollback canceled. Rollback can be triggered manually with `/deploy rollback v3.7.1`.

maria: follow-up actions: 1) add debounce + rate-limit sanity to release notes 2) create postmortem if probe failures continue 3) validate KV cache warmup step on canary

kevin: I'll draft a short release note bullet and a runbook tweak now.

joanne: scheduling a small change window on Monday 09:00 UTC to re-run synthetic load with adjusted settings.

maria: thanks all. tagging this thread for release notes and incident tracker. :white_check_mark:
